messages:
maya: Heads up — planning a staggered deploy for routing-v2, will toggle ff:new-routing during rollout. Plan: internal 0.5% -> beta 2% -> canary 10% -> ramp 50% -> full 100%. Pin runtime to router-v3.2.1 for first two waves. Hold 5m after each wave for telemetry.

sam: quick Q — what are our rollback gates? need clear thresholds before we touch prod traffic.

maya: agreed. proposed gates: errors (5xx) > 0.5% sustained over 5m OR p95 latency +50% vs baseline over 5m triggers immediate rollback to previous flag state. Also if token-level cost jumps unexpectedly we pause.

joel: +1. also recommend sticky cohort pin for the canary slice and warm KV cache pre-rollout to avoid initial spike. I'll run a warmup job 10m before wave B.

joel: snippet of rollout config I pushed to infra repo:
```yaml
feature_flag: new-routing
rollout:
  - name: internal
    pct: 0.5
  - name: beta
    pct: 2
  - name: canary
    pct: 10
  - name: ramp
    pct: 50
  - name: full
    pct: 100
pin: router-v3.2.1
hold_minutes: 5
rollback_criteria:
  p95_delta_pct: 50
  errors_pct: 0.5
```

liz: note: add a quick disable path for SRE if we need to kill the flag fast. Prefer rctl command + deploy-bot fallback.

liz: example emergency commands: `rctl ff disable new-routing` OR `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.internal/flags/new-routing/disable -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN"`

deploy-bot: automated: deploy 3921012345 started by maya. FF actions queued: enable new-routing @ 0.5% (internal). Monitors: telemetry.redwood.internal/routing-v2, logs.redwood.internal/streams/3921012345.

maya: I'll update the release notes: "routing-v2: gradual rollout via ff:new-routing, pinned runtime router-v3.2.1 for initial waves. Watch p95 and 5xx errors; rollback criteria documented."

sam: can we add an experiment tag to the rollout so UX teams can correlate evals? if so tag = routing-v2-experiment-3921012345

joel: added the tag. I'll be on-call during the whole window and will watch the tracing dashboard. ping me if holdpoint fails.

maya: thanks all. execute timeline: start now (internal), beta in 20m, canary in 40m, ramp after green checks. If any gate trips, we'll run immediate disable and roll back to router-v3.1.9 pinned state.

deploy-bot: update: internal wave applied. current coverage 0.5%. no errors in first 5m. next holdpoint 15m.

sam: noted. I'll keep an eye on error budgets and latency alarms. :thumbsup:

joel: warmup job finished, caches at 92% hit.

liz: I'll keep the kill command ready and coordinate with infra if we need to evacuate traffic.

maya: closing loop — will post a final summary in #eng-releases when we reach full rollout or if we rollback. thanks!"
